title: Services - Sens*Hac
description: Our strategic interior design method, from brand and spatial diagnosis to opening.

blocks.imageAlt: Visual and material research during the creative process

children.text: We know no two situations are alike, so we offer the flexibility to choose only what you need:
An intensive two-hour session with a dossier delivered 72 hours later.
An audit of your space to identify opportunities and make strategic decisions.
Targeted transformation or styling without layout changes.
Refresh your business’s image and update key elements to align them with your brand.
360° support from the initial idea through to opening.
To create a space completely tailored to your brand.
Step by step: from strategy to opening.

items.title: Spatial diagnosis and strategy
items.summary: Before designing, we analyse your brand and the needs of your business and space so everything works in the same direction.

children.text: We identify commercial challenges and growth goals.
We assess whether the premises can support your business model.

items.title: Creative Concept & 3D
items.summary: We develop a creative concept aligned with your brand and a spatial strategy that enhances customer experience, streamlines operations, and drives sales.

children.text: We bring your brand and values into the interior architecture.
We plan operations, the customer journey and key zones.
We develop furniture, lighting and material selections.
High-fidelity visualisations help you review and approve the space.

items.title: Technical Development
items.summary: We prepare the technical documentation needed to bring the interior design project to life with control and coherence.

children.text: Detailed plans for contractors and trades.
A cost breakdown for materials, furniture and trades.
We adapt the project to the premises’ technical and regulatory requirements.

items.title: Site Supervision & Installation Coordination
items.summary: We accompany execution alongside the site manager and trades to ensure the final result stays true to the approved project.

children.text: We coordinate communication between your needs and the technical team.
Regular visits check technical details and finishes.
We verify quality and that the result reflects your brand vision.

children.text: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

items.title: When is the best time to contact the studio?
items.summary: The earlier we learn about your project, the better. Early stages are critical for spotting opportunities, anticipating decisions, and avoiding layout, cost, or execution issues later on.

children.text: We can join from the earliest phases, while you are shaping the business or considering a space, as well as when you already have premises and need to rethink, transform, or make them work better.

items.title: Do you work outside your city?
items.summary: Yes. The creative phase can be carried out remotely or in a hybrid format, combining online work with in-person visits. We travel for on-site surveys and the critical execution and installation stages.

items.title: Do you handle construction, permits and structural architecture?
items.summary: Our focus is creativity, spatial strategy, and interior design.

children.text: For construction works, permits, and technical projects requiring architects or engineers, we collaborate closely with a trusted network of professionals.

items.title: What does site supervision include?
items.summary: We oversee the proper execution of the interior design project: checking placement, defining partitions and construction details, and controlling finishes, materials, and furniture installation so the result matches the design.

children.text: Please note, however, that the technical and legal direction of the works corresponds to the construction company and/or the appointed technical professional.

items.title: How are project fees calculated?
items.summary: Fees are defined based on the scope, complexity, and specific needs of each project. Before starting, you will receive a detailed proposal outlining everything included and the fees, so you have complete clarity from the outset.

children.text: In addition, every Friday you will receive an email with project progress and updates, whether or not we met that week.

items.title: Do you work with your own builder, or can I choose my trades?
items.summary: We work with a network of professionals and trades we know first-hand, especially in bespoke joinery, metalwork, lighting, and furniture. We rely on them to ensure the level of quality, precision, and finish each project requires.

children.text: And if you already have a builder or trusted trades, we can coordinate with them and work together to develop the project and ensure proper execution.

items.title: Can I buy my own materials?
items.summary: Material selection is carried out together to translate brand identity into the space. From the studio we centralise supply and coordination, prioritising trusted national manufacturers to guarantee quality, lead times, and budget.

children.text: If you already have certain materials or suppliers identified, we can evaluate them to incorporate and coordinate them within the project.
